classification.difficultyReason: Several linked decisions using the demonstrated definitions or procedures. Both round brackets exclude the shared finite endpoint 1. Page 44 supplies the two unbounded directions; page 49 supplies union membership.

content.prompt:
Sketch the following on a number line.
$$(-\infty,1)\cup(1,\infty)$$

answer.short: The whole real number line except $1$, with an open circle at $1$.
answer.worked: The union contains $x<1$ or $x>1$. Neither interval includes $1$, so draw rays in both directions with an open circle at $1$.

spec.mathematics: All real numbers except 1; one open marker at 1 and outward arrows.
